findings.title: `review_slot_engine_source` can name `role.reviewer` for a slot that came from the session-independent fallback, contradicting its documented status-1 contract
`orchid_journal_once`'s dedup window is described as 40 journal entries, but `journal show --task` reads `tail -n 40` lines, i.e. about 20 entries

`drive_capability_refusal` calls `orchid_journal_once` unguarded, so a failed journal write aborts the pass before the `operator-handoff` boundary is set, unlike `orchid-launch`'s stated best-effort degrade
